input: Can the company terminate me without giving any reason?
expected_output: Yes. Unless you have a written employment agreement that says otherwise, employment is 'at-will,' meaning employees may be terminated with or without cause, and employees are also free to leave employment with or without cause.

input: If I face harassment at work, who do I go and complain to?
expected_output: You should report the incident immediately to your supervisor or to the Executive Director. If the allegation of harassment is against the Executive Director, you should notify the staff member designated as grievance officer.

input: Sir, what are the normal office timings here?
expected_output: The normal work week consists of five 7-hour days. Ordinarily, work hours are from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, including one hour (unpaid) for lunch.

input: Do we get extra pay for working overtime?
expected_output: Overtime pay, applicable only to Non-Exempt Employees, is for any time worked in excess of 40 hours in a work week. The overtime rate is one and a half times the employee's straight time rate, except on Sundays or holidays when it is two times the regular rate.

input: Does the company provide health insurance?
expected_output: Yes, the organization currently provides individual health and dental insurance benefits for eligible full-time and part-time employees, except those insured through their spouse, retired military, or other plans, beginning after the first full month of employment.

input: How much vacation leave do I get in my very first year?
expected_output: During the first 90 days of employment, employees do not earn vacation benefits. During the remaining nine months of the first year, a full-time employee will earn two weeks (10 days) of paid vacation.

input: How many sick leaves do we earn per month?
expected_output: Sick leave benefits are earned on a prorated basis of one day (7 hours) per month for full-time employees, beginning on their first day of employment.

input: How much notice do I need to give before resigning?
expected_output: The organization encourages employees to provide at least two weeks (10 days) written notice prior to intended separation.

input: Is my office email private, or can the company read it?
expected_output: No, it is not private. All data in the organization's computer and communication systems, including documents, e-mail, and recorded voice mail messages, are the property of the organization, which may inspect and monitor such data at any time. No individual should have any expectation of privacy for messages or data in these systems.

input: What is the company's stand on equal opportunity in jobs?
expected_output: The organization is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, disability, political affiliation, personal appearance, family responsibilities, matriculation, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or local law. Each person is evaluated on the basis of personal skill and merit.
